channel.title: NetVista Studio News
channel.description: Development notes, released beta milestones and clearly labelled previews from NetVista Studio.

item.title: Development preview: native mobile creative workspaces after Beta 7
item.description: Newer source adds native mobile creative workspaces and stronger checks. These development previews do not replace the public Beta 7 downloads. Development preview—not a downloadable release. Recorded milestone: 20 October 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.

item.title: NetVista Studio Beta 7: standalone mobile editing and a dedicated 3D workspace
item.description: Beta 7 paired a dedicated Mac modelling workspace with first standalone iPad and Android video editors, each with a clearly defined scope. Development retrospective. Recorded milestone: 7 October 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.

item.title: Beta 6 makes Studio Home clearer and startup quieter
item.description: Game Maker became easier to reach from Studio Home, recent games gained a filter, and background account reads stopped prompting at startup. Development retrospective. Recorded milestone: 29 September 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.

item.title: Beta 4 expands photo, colour, 3D and Game Maker tools
item.description: Mac photo, grading, scene and game workflows expanded, with recovery-aware in-place updating and explicit limits for other editions. Development retrospective. Recorded milestone: 19 September 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.

item.title: Beta 3 brings a separate native photo workspace to Mac
item.description: Layered photo documents gained their own native Mac workspace, while effects browsing, grading feedback and export presentation improved. Development retrospective. Recorded milestone: 3 September 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.

item.title: Two focused betas make video export clearer and more reliable
item.description: Resolution selection moved earlier, export progress became easier to follow, and longer Windows/Linux renders received a reliability fix. Development retrospective. Recorded milestone: 20–28 August 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.

item.title: Windows and Linux join NetVista Studio as 3D animation develops
item.description: Native Windows and Linux packages expanded desktop access, while the next beta developed Mac scene animation and checked, data-only Mods. Development retrospective. Recorded milestone: 13–14 August 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.

item.title: NetVista Studio's first public source and Mac beta
item.description: The earliest public source already contained a native Mac editor. Its first packaged beta followed with timeline, colour and 3D tools. Development retrospective. Recorded milestone: 10–13 August 2026. First published: 21 October 2026.
